crossRefs.note: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
Therefore “ ‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with…
Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
Then the Spirit entered into me, and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside…
But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among…
“Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts much troubled me, and my face was changed in me; but I…
Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to…
Therefore I am full of Yahweh’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and…
For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, “Violence and destruction!” because Yahweh’s word has been made a reproach…
If I say, I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning…

translations.web: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled me with indignation.
translations.bsb: I never sat with the band of revelers, nor did I celebrate with them. Because Your hand was on me, I sat alone, for You have filled me with indignation.
translations.kjv: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.
translations.asv: I sat not in the assembly of them that make merry, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand; for thou hast filled me with indignation.
